reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the pasted bookmarklet capture with Jacob Kennedy
source: bookmarklet capture via the Woo Store API, 8 of 8 products
review: The first complete capture in the set: the sitemap lists 8 products and the scan holds 8. Nothing is being inferred from a sample here.

A NON-EMPTY include LIST, AND THE ONE UNTYPED ROW IS WHY. 'VIP Members Only' at $1.00 has no product type, no description, no SKU and one stock photo. It is a membership, and the classifier files it into Battlestation on the store's own room fallback, so without the include list the shelf would carry a one dollar card that is not a thing. Naming the two real types drops it, which is the mechanism this repo already prefers: a per-merchant list written from that merchant's capture, never a new global regex.

That leaves 7 of 8 published: six mini keyboards and one phone keyboard case. Every one of them classifies to battlestation on its own title, so the room assignment is not resting on the store fallback.
$99 to $179, everything in stock, every product has an image. This is the healthiest feed reviewed so far.

THE ENTITY BUG IS CONFIRMED IN A SECOND MERCHANT. 'BBQ20KBD Mini BlackBerry-Style Keyboard – Black' is the product's own name in the feed, so before the decoder landed this card would have read '–' where the dash belongs. POWOXI found it, this one proves it was never about POWOXI.
REGISTRY HAD THE PLATFORM WRONG. Third in a row: it said shopify, the Woo Store API answered. Corrected. See the platform note in _stores.js.
No affiliate ref yet. It ships anyway, per the publishable() rule, and ?debug names it as unattributed.
